Select the ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against the neuropeptide S receptor (CHEMBL5162). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to match the target. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL5162 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
